science.question: Whether two-step shared/specific representation controls selectively reduce irrelevant label information rather than indiscriminately degrading all predictive information.
source_basis: paper S3.SS1.p1 defines independent shared/specific latent blocks, linear mixing, latent labels and probing
A8.SS1.p1 specifies Gaussian variance 0.5, uniform mixing, training corruption and split
S3.SS1.p3 reports all accuracies declining; that alone does not establish selective retention
original dataset.py supports label generator/corruption details absent from paper
science.cpu_plausibility: Synthetic dense arrays, modest solver-selected MLPs and CPU torch can support the question without reproducing real-data GPU experiments. vMF sampling, two-stage losses and controlled probes remain substantial solver work. No complete research run or feasibility timing was performed; 4 CPU/4096 MB/2048 MB disk/256 PIDs/2400 seconds is an unvalidated task envelope, not promised sufficient.
science.difficulty_preservation: Do not replace vMF or two-stage objective by an easier baseline, alter covariance/noise to obtain positive results, expose author algorithm code as starter, or require author accuracy replication. H1/H2 are explicitly scoped strengthened operational hypotheses, not verbatim author conclusions. Valid negative/inconclusive outcomes remain legitimate.
science.autonomy: Current task already leaves sample size, model architecture, representation dimensions, optimizer/epochs/batch, tau/kappa, grids, seeds/repeats and probe settings to solver. Appendix author 90000 samples, width512 and full beta/lambda grids must not become required recipes. Fixed latent/observation dimensions and label generator describe this released synthetic test object; independent review should check whether they are overprescriptive, not silently shrink them for CPU.

findings.confidence: confirmed wording inconsistency; semantic adjudication needed
findings.evidence: task.md section2 H2 defines greater absolute drops relative to lambda0 but then says proportional drops falsify H2
findings.meaning: Proportional relative declines can have unequal absolute declines when initial accuracies differ. These clauses can disagree while both post-intervention accuracies remain above chance. Solver-selectable tolerance does not define what proportional means.
findings.repair_boundary: Clarify one consistent selective-information comparison from the existing hypothesis; retain both modalities, noncollapse condition, zero-setting comparison and freedom of statistical design. Do not rewrite hypothesis to guarantee support.

findings.confidence: static robustness gap, not observed runtime failure
findings.evidence: simdata.py write_result uses json.dumps with default allow_nan and read_results uses permissive json.loads; task requires JSON records and real measured numbers
findings.meaning: Nonfinite numerical diagnostics can serialize NaN/Infinity, invalid strict JSON. Finite successful runs unaffected.
findings.repair_boundary: Explicitly represent failed/nonfinite runs without inventing numbers or dropping them. No helper executed in this inspection.

findings.confidence: public contract ambiguity, not proven algorithm defect
findings.evidence: package F-D02 public EXP fact states source label seeds (0,1,2) and says EXP fixes construction; task grants solver seed control and simdata uses SeedSequence-derived label seeds
findings.meaning: Distinguish private author provenance from public defining generator contract; author exact seeds are unnecessary experimental recipe. The generated distributions remain supported.
findings.repair_boundary: Independent review should resolve consistency without forcing author seeds or changing generator noise/latent distribution.

findings.evidence: simdata returns true latents for diagnostics; task describes unsupervised representation objectives and probe train/test split
findings.meaning: Make clear true latents/labels cannot replace unsupervised representation learning, and held-out labels cannot select settings. This audit has NOT observed misuse and does not claim the existing implicit boundary proves a scientific defect.
